text:
- [LCYC.6.3] **Cross-tier edges.** Cross-tier publish/
  subscribe creates edges between rule graphs
  on different tiers; the receiving tier asserts what
  crosses under its own schema ([LTIE.9.4]). The
  compile-time cycle check does not follow those
  edges — it runs per-tier — so a cycle
  that closes across a tier boundary is not
  detected.
